data.name: Ultimate Combat
data.detailed_description:
✦ AUTHENTIC MARTIAL ARTS

Experience a fighting game built on real combat physics. No cinematic distractions: just pixel-perfect hitboxes, raw timing, and faithful reproductions of genuine martial arts techniques!

⚔  DIVERSE STYLES & ROSTER

Choose your fighter from a roster mastering unique styles—from the precise discipline of Traditional Karate to the raw brutality of Street Fighting. Pure 90s arcade adrenaline built for endless replayability. Choose your character and fight in the ultimate scenarios!

🌐  EARLY ACCESS MULTIPLAYER

Take the fight online! Battle worldwide via Public Matchmaking or challenge friends in Private Lobbies via room codes. (Note: Netcode is actively optimized during Early Access with community feedback).

🔥 A GIFT FOR MARTIAL ARTS & FIGHTING GAME FANS

Developed by a real martial artist for everyone who shares a passion for combat sports and fighting games. Whether you practice in real life or love the strategy and impact of combat, this experience is for you!

data.short_description: A refined 3D fighting game born as a love letter to 90s arcade games. A gem crafted with attention to detail, featuring pixel-perfect hitboxes, visceral combos, and pure martial arts action. Step into the ring, master the combat system, and experience the fight!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200 o AMD FX-4100
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 2500 o AMD Radeon R5
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 o AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 o AMD Radeon HD 7750
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
